samples.summary: Dropping `href` from CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE removes the last user-reachable bulk way to strip an attacker-supplied href, while href ingestion still performs no scheme validation (defense-in-depth only, no exploit found)
samples.evidence: Attacker path: victim pastes HTML from an attacker-controlled page (or an attacker-authored internal clipboard payload) into a docs/slides text surface. `parseHtmlToBlocks` stores the anchor's href verbatim — `packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:610-613` (`const href = el.getAttribute('href'); if (href) style.href = href;`), duplicated in `collectInlines` at :711-715, and the internal-payload sanitizer accepts any string at :148-149 (`if (href !== undefined) style.href = href;`). So `javascript:alert(1)` / `data:text/html,...` can be persisted into the CRDT. Before this change, Clear formatting (select-all → `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`, which contained `href: undefined`) stripped every such href in one action; after `packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:300-315` drops the key, the only removal command is `removeLink`, which is per-link and caret-driven (docs popover only; slides gets the new toolbar button). I traced every consumer I could find and all of them currently gate: Ctrl+click and the read-only click path (`packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1822`, `:2176` — `isSafeUrl` before `window.open`), the link popover (`packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-link-popover.tsx:217,224`), PDF export (`packages/docs/src/export/pdf-painter.ts:903`), Markdown export (`packages/docs/src/serialize/markdown.ts:248`), and PPTX export (`packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:279-283` plus `escapeXmlAttr` on the rel target in `zip.ts:56`). So this is not exploitable today — it is a defense-in-depth regression: the model is now the long-term store of unsanitized, effectively unremovable URLs, and `packages/docs/src/serialize/markdown.ts:424` itself records that "[n]othing validates it on the way into the model". Any future consumer that renders `style.href` into a DOM anchor/export without repeating the gate becomes stored XSS. Suggested hardening: run pasted/imported hrefs through `normalizeLinkUrl`/`isSafeUrl` at the ingestion boundary (clipboard.ts), the way the PPTX importer already does at `packages/slides/src/import/pptx/text.ts:557`.
searchedFor: read packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:590-726 (HTML paste href handling) and :140-175 (internal payload sanitizer)
grep href in packages/docs/src/export and packages/docs/src/serialize (PDF + Markdown gates)
grep href/hlink in packages/slides/src (import allowlist isSafeHref, export isExportableHref, zip.ts escapeXmlAttr)
grep '<a href|href=${|hyperlink' repo-wide for any DOM/HTML emission of a doc href

samples.summary: New always-enabled "Remove link" button invokes an optional method (`editor.removeLink?.()`), so a surface that opts into `showRemoveLink` without implementing it silently no-ops while appearing to succeed
samples.evidence: `handleRemoveLink` calls `editor.removeLink?.()` (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:176) and `removeLink` is declared optional on the shared contract (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/types.ts:104). The button is rendered unconditionally enabled whenever `showRemoveLink` is passed and an editor is mounted (no `getLinkAtCursor()` gate, by design per the comment at :167-172). Since #1051 removed href from Clear formatting, `removeLink` is now the ONLY way to defuse a hyperlink whose visible text disagrees with its target (a phishing/UI-spoofing case in a shared deck), so a silent no-op gives the user false assurance the link is gone. Today both opt-ins are safe — `state.textEditor` is a `SlidesTextBoxEditor`, which implements `removeLink` (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650), for desktop (toolbar/text-edit-section.tsx:93) and mobile (toolbar/mobile-toolbar.tsx:580) — so there is no impact on this branch; the hazard is structural for future opt-ins. Making the prop require a `removeLink`-bearing editor type (or disabling the button when the method is absent) would close it.
searchedFor: grep removeLink across packages (slides SlidesTextBoxEditor, docs EditorAPI, frontend surfaces)
